story.title: Story 1: Thread, Actor, Message, And Part Store

result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification of Story 1 against the published story, full tech design, and test plan; inspected the thread-store/thread-service implementation and supporting test helpers, reviewed the implementor artifact, audited the production runtime paths for fake behavior, ran `npm run verify`, `npm run green-verify`, and `npm run verify-all`, and executed a focused managed-thread association reproduction.

newFindings.title: Managed-thread fallback can silently merge different PI sessions into one canonical thread
newFindings.evidence: `findManagedThread()` falls back from the root target-key index to `cwd` / `currentGeneratedFilePath` heuristics (`src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:213-245`, `src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:900-960`), and `openOrCreateManagedThread()` then merges the incoming target onto that thread (`src/context-steward/services/thread-service.ts:75-115`). In a focused reproduction during this review, creating thread A with only `sessionFilePath` and then opening a different `sessionId`-only target that merely shared the same `cwd` returned the same `threadId` and rewrote thread A to `sessionId: "session-b"` instead of creating a new thread. That violates the published target-key contract, which limits association to `sessionId` / `sessionFilePath` keys (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/tech-design.md:595-616`) and Story 1's note to use canonical/alias key rules only (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/stories/01-thread-actor-message-part-store.md:155-164`). The current unit suite locks this heuristic in rather than guarding against cross-session collisions (`tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts:201-255`).

additionalObservations: Production-path audit did not find fake adapters, shims, placeholder branches, or mock-only runtime behavior in the reviewed Story 1 runtime code; the blocker is real association logic on the production path.
`npm run verify-all` exited 0 but reported `No integration tests found.`, so the epic gate currently adds no extra integration signal beyond the unit suite.

`npm run green-verify` also exited 0 even though `tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts` is currently untracked (`git status --short` shows `?? tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts`), because `guard:no-test-changes` only checks tracked diffs in `package.json:15-18`.
